newsitem.title: USA: Integon says replaces chief actuary.
newsitem.headline: Integon says replaces chief actuary.

text.p: Auto insurer Integon Corp said it has replaced its chief actuary and expanded its actuarial staff after the company reported a disappointing first quarter loss.

Joining the company are Curtis M. Parker, vice president and chief actuary; Daniel C. Pickens, assistant vice president and assistant actuary; and Daniel D. Blau, assistant vice president and assistant actuary.
"Their job is to ensure that loss reserves and product pricing are adequate and remain adequate," Integon chairman and chief executive John Head said.
Integon also said its search for a new chief executive will continue, but may be delayed.
James Lambie resigned as chief executive of Integon in November.
Trading in Integon was delayed after the company reported first quarter results. The shares closed Friday at 13-3/8 and were indicated at nine, 9-1/2 on the New York Stock Exchange.
